question:
Identify the diagram that best represents the relationship among the given classes.

Engineer, Doctor, Lawyer
solution:
**Given: **Engineer, Doctor, Lawyer

The logic followed here is:

Some Engineers can be Doctor.

Some Doctor can be Lawyer.

Some Lawyer can be Engineer.

Some Lawyers can be Doctor as well Engineer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc37fe5513d5f17723204a354f2b64815a9755ff80c1201698cee6821f2b4f56.png] Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
